activity.title: The recent fires in LA have been devastating, and our hearts go out to everyone affected. In the midst of such challenges, we're inspired by the ingenuity of our users who leverage technology to support communities in need. One contributor, Shashank Shriram , built a data app using Preswald to visualize data from the fires, helping make critical information more accessible. We're grateful to see our product used in meaningful ways during difficult times. If you're working on projects to assist with relief or recovery efforts, we’d love to support you. Please reach out.

Four weeks in already! Officially one month into my SWE internship at Google Mountain View. 🚀 I'm slowly learning my way around the codebase, but navigating a gBike across this massive campus without getting lost is another story. 🚲 Getting to work on a product as impactful as YouTube as part of the Trust & Safety team has been both surreal and incredibly rewarding. A huge thank you to: • Minh Luong and Kelan I. for their constant guidance and being such great intern hosts. • Ivan Dewerpe , Ruihang Du , Nielsen Angrio , Juhyoung L. , Colin Le , Devadutt Sanka , Aneesha Thangeda , Avanti, and Sushil for such a warm welcome, and helping me navigate my first few weeks. • my recruiter America Rodriguez for all her support and for making this entire opportunity possible. Excited to see what else I can build over the next months and learn from the incredible team at YouTube Trust & Safety! #Google #GoogleInterns #SoftwareEngineering #YouTube #LifeAtGoogle

After a long journey of navigating a challenging job landscape, I am incredibly excited to share that I’ve secured a Software Engineer I - ML position at Cadence Design Systems! This milestone wouldn’t have been possible without the incredible support of Ram Iyer , Subhendu Roy , and their team. I also want to extend a huge thank you to my recruiters Franchon Warmack and Jayne M. Matsuda for their amazing support and guidance in helping me navigate the process all the way to the final offer letter. I am thrilled to dive into the world of machine learning and apply graph algorithms to solve critical hardware design challenges at Cadence and collaborate with such a talented group. Looking forward to what lies ahead! Special thanks to Cadence for providing an incredible opportunity and an exciting atmosphere that greatly values innovation. I am proud to join a company that is at the forefront of solving cutting-edge technological challenges.

Yesterday marked a very important day in my academic journey: I've officially accepted my offer of admission for UC Davis' Masters program in Civil and Environmental Engineering! My intended specialization is going to be in Water Resources Engineering. I plan to use this degree to study groundwater flow and contaminant transport to boost a career in designing environmental solutions for soil and groundwater remediation. I want to thank the program coordinator Lauren Worrell and the department chair Chris Cappa for their guidance in the application process. I also want to thank, Dr. Marc Beutel , Dr. Peggy O'Day, Dr. Abbas Ghassemi, and every other professor that gave me their full support and encouragement along the way. Looking forward to joining the Aggie family this fall! #UCDavisEngineering #CivilEnvironmentalEngineering #WaterResourcesEngineering #Groundwater #ContaminantTransport #EnvironmentalRemediation #EnvironmentalConsulting #Fall2026
